name: indiff-independent-windows-preview
description: Independent local UI platform preview, not the original INDIFF application

scripts.pack: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.check: node --check main.mjs && node --check host-core.mjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check prepare-web.mjs
scripts.pack:portable: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.portable.json
scripts.dist:portable: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.portable.json
